# Get Stock Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given stock.

## Syntax

~~~~text
stockDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, stock: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
stockDetail(detail: price, stock: stock)
~~~~
